import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String s = br.readLine();
        process_string(s);
    }

    public static void process_string(String input) {
        boolean at_done = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < input.length(); ++i) {
            if (!at_done && i + 1 < input.length() && 
                input.charAt(i) == 'a' && input.charAt(i+1) == 't' && 
                i > 0 && i+1 < input.length()-1) {
                System.out.print('@');
                at_done = true;
                ++i;
            } else if (i + 2 < input.length() && 
                       input.charAt(i) == 'd' && 
                       input.charAt(i+1) == 'o' && 
                       input.charAt(i+2) == 't' && 
                       i > 0 && i+2 < input.length()-1) {
                System.out.print('.');
                i += 2;
            } else {
                System.out.print(input.charAt(i));
            }
        }
    }
}
